campbell.title: Campbell City Council — July 7, 2026
campbell.summary: The Campbell City Council held public hearings on renewing an interim ordinance tied to state Senate legislation, and on revoking the business license and tobacco retailer permits for two local shops, California Cigar and Hayes Smoke Shop. The council also considered a resolution to apply for a One Bay Area Grant for public works funding and reviewed proposed consultant service agreements.
keyTopics: Renewal of an interim ordinance implementing state Senate legislation
Revocation of business license and tobacco retailer permit for California Cigar
Revocation of business license and tobacco retailer permit for Hayes Smoke Shop
Authorization to submit a One Bay Area Grant application through the Public Works Director
Approval of new consultant service agreements

saratoga.title: Saratoga City Council — May 6, 2026
saratoga.summary: The Saratoga City Council considered routine steps for an annual assessment district, including preliminary approval of an Engineer's Report and a Resolution of Intention, followed by a public hearing on the matter. The council also discussed whether to pursue charter city status and reviewed early estimates of possible new tax options and the revenue they could generate.
keyTopics: Preliminary approval of the Engineer's Report for the annual assessment district
Public hearing and Resolution of Intention related to the assessment district
Scheduling an ordinance for adoption at the May 20, 2026 meeting
Discussion of charter city status and direction to staff
Review of potential new tax options and revenue estimates

los-gatos.title: Los Gatos Town Council — August 4, 2026
los-gatos.summary: The Los Gatos Town Council reviewed routine administrative and financial business, including approving minutes from prior meetings and considering several contract amendments for ongoing town services. The council also considered authorizing the purchase of library books and materials and reviewed the town's monthly financial and investment report.
keyTopics: Approval of minutes from the June 16 and June 23, 2026 council meetings
Contract amendments for town service agreements, including tree care services with Brightview Tree Care
Extension of a legal services contract (fifth amendment)
Authorization to purchase library books and materials through Ingram for the fiscal year
Review of the town's monthly financial and investment report

san-jose.title: San José City Council — August 5, 2026
san-jose.summary: This was a procedural agenda-setting meeting where the City Council reviewed and organized the upcoming August 11 and August 18, 2026 council meeting agendas. Council members considered adding new items, scheduling specific start times for certain topics, and reviewing any requests to waive normal agenda rules. The council also reviewed the public record covering city business from June 11 through July 29, 2026.
keyTopics: Finalizing the August 11, 2026 council meeting agenda
Shaping the draft agenda for the August 18, 2026 meeting
Assigning specific ('time certain') time slots to agenda items
Reviewing requests to waive standard agenda notice requirements
Reviewing the public record for June 11–July 29, 2026

mountain-view.title: Mountain View City Council — June 23, 2026
mountain-view.summary: The Mountain View City Council met to handle several routine city business items alongside some celebratory recognitions. The council considered the city's annual budget limits, updates to financial policy, a long-term water supply plan, and next year's list of capital construction projects, plus a closed-door discussion on potential lawsuits against the city.
keyTopics: Closed session on potential litigation against the city (two possible cases)
Proclamations for Immigrant Heritage Month, the Kiwanis Club's 100th anniversary, and City Attorney Jennifer Logue's judicial appointment
Setting the city's legal spending limit for 2026-27 and updating financial/budget policy rules
Adoption of the 5-Year Urban Water Management and Water Shortage Contingency Plan
Review of the 2026-27 capital improvement program, including the Public Safety Building project, Shoreline Golf Links parking lot repaving, and South Bay Salt Pond restoration work

sunnyvale.title: Sunnyvale City Council — July 28, 2026
sunnyvale.summary: The Sunnyvale City Council met on July 28, 2026, starting with a closed session followed by a study session focused on updates to the city's artificial turf policy. The council also handled routine business, including approving city bills, amending a landfill services contract, and authorizing unpaid utility charges to be added to property tax bills.
keyTopics: Artificial Turf Policy Study Update discussion
Closed session (confidential matters not open to the public)
Amendment to landfill services agreement with SCS Field Services, Inc.
Placing delinquent utility charges onto the county property tax roll for 2026/27
Routine approval of city bills and claims paid by the City Manager

cupertino.title: Cupertino City Council — July 21, 2026
cupertino.summary: The Cupertino City Council met in a closed session with legal counsel to discuss three ongoing lawsuits against the city. These cases involve disputes over housing and development-related issues, including a challenge from a pro-housing advocacy group and a coalition concerned about street safety on Mary Avenue. No public discussion or vote details are disclosed for closed session items.
keyTopics: Lawsuit: Lixin (Leon) Chen, et al. v. City of Cupertino
Lawsuit: Yes in My Backyard, et al. v. City of Cupertino
Lawsuit: Garden Gate Coalition for Mary Avenue Safety v. City of Cupertino
Closed-session legal counsel briefing on existing litigation

santa-clara.title: Santa Clara City Council — May 26, 2026
santa-clara.summary: The Santa Clara City Council and Stadium Authority Board held a special joint meeting to consider a $1.6 million agreement with the California Highway Patrol for traffic management services tied to the FIFA World Cup, along with a related budget amendment to fund it. The meeting was held in a hybrid format, allowing residents to attend in person or watch and participate remotely via Zoom.
keyTopics: Joint City Council/Stadium Authority Board special meeting
Agreement with California Highway Patrol for FIFA World Cup traffic management
$1.6 million projected cost for CHP traffic services
Related budget amendment to cover the CHP agreement
Hybrid public participation via in-person attendance and Zoom

milpitas.title: Milpitas City Council — April 7, 2026
milpitas.summary: The Milpitas City Council considered a substantial amendment to its 2025-2030 Consolidated Plan and 2025-2026 funding allocations, which guide how the city uses federal housing and community development funds. The council also reviewed a list of new workplan items requested by individual councilmembers and considered an ordinance change to how it fills council vacancies and shortens related timelines, alongside routine business like meeting minutes and upcoming calendar items.
keyTopics: Amendment to the 2025-2030 Consolidated Plan and 2025-2026 funding allocations
New workplan item requests submitted by individual councilmembers
Proposed ordinance changes to the Council vacancy-filling process and timeline
Approval of prior City Council meeting minutes
Preview of items planned for the next regular Council meeting

palo-alto.title: Palo Alto City Council — July 8, 2026
palo-alto.summary: The Palo Alto City Council opened with a routine Director's Report covering meeting schedules and committee assignments, followed by a public hearing on a rezoning proposal for 470 Olive Avenue. The council considered changing the property's zoning from single-family residential to medium-density mixed use, along with an update to the North Ventura Coordinated Area Plan's land use designation, to align it with the mixed-use zoning already in place next door at 2951 El Camino Real.
keyTopics: Rezoning of 470 Olive Avenue from single-family residential (NV-R1) to medium-density mixed use (NV-MXM)
Proposed amendment to the North Ventura Coordinated Area Plan land use designation
Aligning zoning with the adjacent parcel at 2951 El Camino Real
Director's Report on upcoming meeting schedule and council assignments
